# The Gallitano Studio

> The Gallitano Studio advises C-suite executives and enterprise leadership benches on narrative authority, reputation architecture, and presence where it matters most. For senior executives, and the ones on their way.

The Gallitano Studio is Gallitano Creative LLC. Founder: Angela Gallitano. Website: https://thegallitanostudio.com/

A plain summary of the site for AI systems and search tools. The wording below is taken from the site. Last updated: 2026-10-23.

## Who it is

- Angela Gallitano is the founder of The Gallitano Studio, an executive story and presence advisory.
- For senior executives, and the ones on their way: CxOs, SVPs, VPs, board directors and executive teams.
- For companies: I partner with CEOs, CHROs, and executive sponsors to sharpen individual leadership narratives so they reinforce the broader company vision.
- One of three leaders of LinkedIn's global Rock Your Profile program. Then Gartner, working with CHROs, CIOs and their executive teams. Today, Salesforce Enterprise AI. I build with agentic AI daily, and I teach leaders to do the same.
- 350+ rooms since 2020. 125+ executives one to one. 15+ industries.
- Global footprint: The US, the UK, EMEA and APAC.
- Based in Huntsville and Madison, Alabama.
- The name came in 2022: Gallitano Creative, built around the art of personal storytelling. The Gallitano Studio is what that work became.
- The Gallitano Studio is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by any employer.

## What she does

Executive presence is no longer confined to the boardroom. It precedes you.

Your story is already being told. The question is who's telling it.

No one can write your leadership story for you. Together, we articulate your institutional legacy and strategic domain ownership. Then we make sure it's found in the right places, at the moments that matter.

- Before the first meeting
- Before the board interview
- On the stage
- Every time they search your name

## Programs for leaders

- [Known For First Look](https://thegallitanostudio.com/work-with-me/first-look/): the 2-week strategic narrative sprint. Your career outran your public presence. In two weeks, we align them: the Narrative Diagnostic, the Executive Dossier (your LinkedIn, executive bio and résumé) and the Calibration.
- [Known For Executive](https://thegallitanostudio.com/work-with-me/executive/): a 6-month retainer that opens with 30 days of the Accelerator. The 6-month retained advisory: a comprehensive, retained partnership that anchors your authority and stays beside you as the room changes.
- [ExecutiveOS](https://thegallitanostudio.com/executiveos/): one leader's AI, built for them inside the tools their company already approves. It knows their story, their voice and the work in front of them.

## For companies

- [Known For Leadership Collective](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/#collective): for the bench. Enterprise cohort advisory, 30 to 90 days. It opens with Known For Live, an intensive alignment session with the full leadership group, then structured 1:1 advisory sessions with each executive.
- [1:1 Executive Advisory](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/#sponsor): for the successor. Known For Executive, sponsored by the company, for a single executive.
- [The business case](https://thegallitanostudio.com/for-companies/business-case/)

## How it works

The Known For Method, three stages: Narrative Diagnostic. The Known For Architecture. Executive Surface Deployment.

Your LinkedIn, your bio and your site are collateral. The work is narrative architecture and category ownership.

Every engagement is strictly guarded, so you'll see roles here, never names.

Investment will be shared in our 20-minute conversation.
